report.question: Use persistent investigation tools to test a motion hypothesis of your choice. Inspect actual code, enter gameplay, choose a checkpoint, fork an unchanged control and experimental branch, select a bounded typed mutation, and compare identical inputs. You may use explicitly human-mapped field hints, but must not claim you discovered their layout. Base your next action on the returned measurements. Capture one informative framebuffer if useful. Record supported/rejected/unresolved findings and cite the comparison ID in your conclusion. Prioritize one complete controlled experiment; do not browse the entire binary.

Concise conclusion from recorded evidence only:

Observations:
- `inspect_wasm` target-001 sha256 `152d44c6e9ef...` : WASM-4 `update` export + `start`.
- `list_functions` + `inspect_function` binary:func11 `$update`: frame dispatch on `i32.load8_u [18480]-1 br_table`, title branch draws rects/text via `$env.rect/$env.textUtf8/$f86`. Code inspection only; no motion-store traced.
- `exp-001` main:
  - obs-0001 start-game frame 10: text `Wave:1 Enemies:0 Score:99`, motion `x:0 y:0 cooldown:1` hints x@22397/y@22401.
  - obs-0002 settle frame 40: `Enemies:1 Score:96`, motion `x:0 y:0 cooldown:0`.
  - obs-0003 move-right frame 70: after 30f right-hold, text `Enemies:1 Score:93`, motion `x:60 y:0` hints x@22013/y@22017, player-like sprite `17050: [86,76]` vs prior `76,76` sprites, background group `17640` shifted `22->122` etc.
- checkpoint `cp-add78e465ef6200e69a9` frame 70 verified.
- fork `ctrl` obs-0004 frame 70 hash-identical restore verified.

Interpretation:
- Correlational only: sustained right input associated with +60 world-x in HUMAN-MAPPED registry and ~+10px sprite shift plus background scroll. Consistent with rightward motion/camera hypothesis, not proven causal.
- Score `99->96->93` ticks down over time independent of claimed move; wave/enemy text changed 0->1 between obs-0001/obs-0002.
- Field hints are HUMAN-MAPPED assistance per motionNotice; layout not independently discovered. Watch names are hypotheses.

Remaining / inconclusive:
- No `compare_branches` completed, so `branchComparison:true` requirement unsatisfied. No causality claim.
- No `diff_memory`, `trace_writers`, `call_graph/decompile`, `capture_frame`, controlled mutation, or `record_finding`/`submit_component_candidate`.
- No extracted candidate; acceptance not attempted.
- Motion source (player vs camera), speed/frames, cooldown/remaining meaning, sprite identity unresolved.

Cited: exp-001, obs-0001, obs-0002, obs-0003, obs-0004, cp-add78e465ef6200e69a9.
